violations.message: MovementController.step(): triggerless branch guarded by 'withinStuckPeriod || advancedBeyondStuckDist' follows event-triggered branch(es): event instanceof chemical_detector.event.InputEvent.Stop, event instanceof chemical_detector.event.InputEvent.Resume — in the extracted model both are enabled together
violations.directive: An event-triggered branch followed by a TRIGGERLESS branch in the same else-if chain has no counterpart in RoboChart: the Java takes only the first branch, but the extracted transitions form an unguarded external choice and the triggerless one is enabled whenever its data guard holds — including when the event is present. RoboChart has no event-absence guard.

violations.message: MovementController.step(): branch guarded by '(!withinStuckPeriod) && (!advancedBeyondStuckDist)' does not negate preceding triggerless guard(s): withinStuckPeriod||advancedBeyondStuckDist
violations.directive: Relying on the implicit priority of else-if produces a formal model whose operations can fire nondeterministically — the extracted preconditions are not mutually exclusive.
Without an explicit RoboChart type, the formal model extraction cannot confidently map Java double to RoboChart real and may produce an incorrect model type.
